name: LOLIN D32 Pro
notes: LOLIN (WEMOS) D32 Pro v2.0.0: 65 x 25.4 mm ESP32-WROVER board (16 MB flash / 8 MB PSRAM on current units, 4 MB flash on early runs) with a CH340C USB bridge, micro-USB, LiPo support (PH-2 connector + TP4054 charger, ~500 mA), a microSD (TF) slot, and SH1.0 connectors for a TFT display (10-pin) and I2C (4-pin).
GPIO16/17 are not on the headers at all - the WROVER's PSRAM uses them, and the two pads at their usual positions are silkscreened NC.
GPIO35 is not broken out - it is hardwired to an onboard 100k/100k divider on the battery: battery voltage = ADC reading x 2.

When the microSD slot and the TFT port are in use they reserve: GPIO4 (TF_CS), GPIO14 (TFT_CS), GPIO27 (TFT_DC), GPIO33 (TFT_RST), GPIO32 (TFT backlight), GPIO12 (touch CS) - all sharing the VSPI bus on GPIO18/19/23.
Blue onboard LED on GPIO5, active LOW. No BOOT button, but the auto-flash circuit (CH340C DTR/RTS) is present, so flashing needs no button presses.

1.label: TX
1.note: UART0 TX, shared with the CH340C USB-serial bridge.

3.label: RX
3.note: UART0 RX, shared with the CH340C USB-serial bridge.

4.note: TF_CS: chip select of the microSD (TF) slot - reserve it when a card is used. The arduino-esp32 d32_pro variant even remaps SS here.

5.label: LED
5.note: Blue onboard LED, active LOW. Default SPI SS on the silicon, remapped to GPIO4 in the arduino-esp32 variant.

12.note: TS_CS on the TFT port (touch controller chip select). Also the MTDI flash-voltage strap: anything pulling it HIGH at boot selects 1.8 V flash and blocks booting.

32.note: TFT_LED (display backlight) on the TFT port.
